SINEWGOD-SINEW_GOD.aromaPrinciple: The strong must protect the weak.
SINEWGOD-SINEW_GOD.banter.dead.endTurnPi: Need a minute to regrow. Can you hold them off for me?
SINEWGOD-SINEW_GOD.cardsModifierDescript: Sinew God cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
SINEWGOD-SINEW_GOD.description: A towering man with a kind heart. An infection transformed him into a shapeshifting monster, but he never let his circumstances stop him from helping those in need. He ascended to godhood after a battle for the fate of the world.
SINEWGOD-SINEW_GOD.eventDeathPrevention: Bad idea. They need me up.
SINEWGOD-SINEW_GOD.goldMonologue: This feels like too much for one person...
SINEWGOD-SINEW_GOD.title: The Sinew God
